description: IBAN validation and formatting (ISO 13616). Validates an IBAN by ISO 13616: checks country code length, recomputes the mod-97 check digits and returns the formatted IBAN with country, check digits, BBAN and a reason when invalid. No external source is used — pure computation. An invalid IBAN returns valid: false. Price $0.005 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
